licence: Apache-2.0 code and weights (HF tag + repo); not gated; no watermark mentioned anywhere
why: In-context cloning (sample audio codes + exact transcript), so timbre, pace and delivery follow the sample. 24 kHz output. Fits the disk (2.52 GB weights) and the GPU (~2.8 GB incl. CUDA context) and runs at ~1.9 s per second of audio on the GTX 1650 after the fixes in worker.py. On Jason it beat Chatterbox-Nano on similarity (0.87 vs 0.82) and matched the sample's pace best (4.36 vs 4.23 words/s).
gtx16xx_fixes: fp16 overflows to inf in the code predictor's MLP (down_proj) -> that 5-layer part runs in fp32; its 15 sub-steps per frame are replayed as one CUDA graph (RTF 4.4 -> 1.9); only 25 sample frames are decoded as context. bf16 is never used.
